title: External Boundary Policy
description: Configuration for scanning the crossings between helyx and services the operator does not control (adoption area A1). The operator channel — replies, instructions, permission prompts between the operator and a session — is inside the trust boundary and is never scanned; it is absent from this schema by design and cannot be added through configuration.

enabled.description: Master switch for boundary scanning. Disabling is an operator decision that is logged at startup.

command.description: How the scanner is invoked. Must include --json: the verdict is read from parsed output, never from the exit code, because keryx exits 0 even when it blocks (verified 2026-08-12, v0.2.16).

timeoutMs.description: Wall-clock budget for one scan. A timeout is a scan failure and takes the crossing's onScanFailure path.

onScanFailure.description: What happens when the scanner cannot run. 'fallback' takes the crossing's declared local alternative where one exists and skips the crossing where none does. There is deliberately no 'proceed' value: an unscanned crossing is the thing this policy exists to prevent. Note that neither value can withhold an operator message, because no operator path is a crossing.

crossings.description: Per-crossing configuration. Keys are the crossing ids from the specification.

E1-remote-tts.description: Reply text leaving for Yandex Cloud, Groq or OpenAI speech synthesis (utils/tts.ts). Fallback: local piper.

E2-transcription.description: Operator voice audio leaving for Groq (utils/transcribe.ts). Raw audio is not scannable content; this crossing is governed by posture (below), not by a payload scan.

E3-aux-llm.description: Prompts and completions to and from DeepSeek or OpenRouter (utils/aux-llm-client.ts). Skipped entirely when the base URL is the local Ollama.

E4-reviewers.description: Project diffs to third-party reviewer models and the reports they return.

E5-session-provider.description: Session content to a non-local provider. Anthropic-direct is still external.

posture.description: Crossings decided by configuration rather than payload. The control here is visibility, not a gate.

remoteTtsOptIn.description: Whether remote speech synthesis may be used at all. False means local piper only, regardless of what a voice preset names.

remoteTranscriptionOptIn.description: Whether the operator's voice audio may leave for a remote transcriber. There is no local fallback today, so false means voice input is unavailable rather than degraded — an honest trade, stated rather than discovered.

reportInStatus.description: Which remote services are active must be visible from a status surface without reading .env. Fixed true: a posture nobody can see is not a posture.

scan.description: Which directions are scanned. 'inbound' content is scanned as untrusted-external before it reaches a session or memory — that is the prompt-injection surface.

onFinding.description: What a blocking finding does. 'fallback' uses the crossing's local alternative (piper for E1); 'skip-crossing' refuses that external call and reports it at the call site. A finding must never cost the operator a message — every value here is satisfiable without touching the operator channel.

localFallback.description: The local alternative used when onFinding is 'fallback'. Null means none exists and the crossing is skipped instead.
